states.title: States
states.description: Which state registries to pull from. Supported: CO (Colorado), CT (Connecticut), NY (New York).

keywords.title: Business name keywords (optional)
keywords.description: Only return businesses whose name contains one of these words, e.g. dental, roofing, consulting, cafe. Empty = all new registrations.

cities.title: Cities (optional)
cities.description: Only return businesses registered in these cities (exact match on the filed city). Empty = statewide.

daysBack.title: Lookback days
daysBack.description: Return registrations filed in the last N days. State feeds update daily.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on lead rows returned, newest first. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip businesses seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned businesses across runs and skip them. Turn on for a scheduled daily new-business feed.
